dedupe_keys.name: lignes et postes electriques edf en guadeloupe

description: Lignes et postes électriques (EDF) en Guadeloupe is a dataset listed in KaruData open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by EDF-SEI. Données relatives aux lignes et postes électriques des réseaux insulaires: longueur (en km) des lignes basse tension (BT), moyenne tension (HTA) et haute tension (HTB), ainsi que le nombre de postes sources et de postes de distribution (HTA/BT). Coverage: Guadeloupe. The portal files it under Aménagement durable du territoire. Its keywords are Lignes, Postes, Réseau, Basse tension, Moyenne tension, Haute tension. The portal shows 12 records. The portal shows 2021-01-26 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-karudata-com-portal.
